deviations.description: Add 'verify' to BimodalSemantics.DEFAULT_EXAMPLE_SETTINGS with early validation
deviations.reason: The settings KEY is 'verify' as specified, but the resolved semantics attribute is stored as self.verify_mode, not self.verify. models/semantic.py's initialize_with_state and iterate/models.py's generic model-rebuild path both use hasattr(semantics, 'verify') as the theory-capability test distinguishing a verify/falsify-based theory (logos, exclusion) from one that is not (bimodal uses truth_condition). Setting self.verify to a string flips that hasattr check to True and crashes the generic iterator ('str' object is not callable) the first time it tries to call semantics.verify(state, atom) as a Z3 constraint builder. Discovered via test_iterate.py::TestLiveIteration failures during Phase 3 full-suite verification; fixed by renaming the attribute (never the settings key) to verify_mode throughout core.py and model.py.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- attribute renamed to verify_mode to avoid colliding with the framework's hasattr(semantics, 'verify') theory-capability test; settings key stays 'verify')*
